summary: Analyzes how protection and recovery for label switched paths work in multi-domain MPLS and GMPLS networks, where paths cross more than one domain. It looks at the schemes and processes already defined for setting up such paths, as described in a framework document, and examines how recovery fits them. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If a train route crosses several countries and a bridge fails, each railway must help fix it. This studies how backup paths work when a route goes through many separate networks.
